extraction.head: db-cleanup-optimized

greptile.text: Summary: The PR has three parts: (1) the cleanup service interval drops from 10 minutes to 1 minute, so all cleanup jobs run 10x more often while keeping the 9-minute timeout; (2) annotation cleanup is restructured into a two-phase approach that fetches IDs into memory and then deletes by ID, with new helpers fetchIDs, deleteByIDs, and untilDoneOrCancelled, plus SQLite parameter-limit handling; (3) annotation cleanup tests are moved to integration tests. The bot flags possible SQL injection, resource cost from the 10x frequency, and wrong log levels. Confidence score of 2/5.
